scope: source/test evidence inventory; no full acceptance certification
baselineHashNormalization: UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF

evidenceIndex.O: [guarded Auto](../core/guarded-auto.cjs), [private API](../core/control-api.cjs), [capture lease](../core/capture-lease.cjs), [power recovery](../core/power-recovery.cjs); [Auto tests](../tests/guarded-auto.test.cjs), [API lifecycle tests](../tests/control-api-lifecycle.test.cjs), [ownership tests](../tests/live-context.test.cjs)

requirements.requirement: Enumerate selectable physical/virtual capture devices with stable ID, channel and format metadata; remember selection without silently substituting.
requirements.acceptance: Given MOTU M4 and another input, when selecting M4/channel and restarting, then the same available ID/channel is chosen; if missing, capture stays off with named error.
requirements.evidence: Exact device ID and channel are stored; capture requests the selected device instead of a default.
requirements.remaining: Expose or qualify device format/channel-capability metadata; verify MOTU identity/channel persistence on each OS.

requirements.requirement: Request microphone permission only when setup/input test needs it; explain denial/revocation recovery for each OS.
requirements.acceptance: Given permission denied then granted in OS settings, when retrying test, then denial shows actionable steps and no capture occurs until grant.
requirements.evidence: Input permission actions, capture cancellation and denial paths exist.
requirements.remaining: Verify OS-specific denial/revocation recovery and improve actionable in-app guidance where only a browser error is shown.

requirements.requirement: Select a mono pastor channel and convert supported sample formats/rates without modifying mixer/live routing.
requirements.acceptance: Given 44.1/48 kHz stereo fixture with speech on one channel, when configured, then output is the chosen channel at recognizer format with duration error ≤1 frame per second and no other-channel mixing.
requirements.evidence: Selected-channel worklet, 16kHz conversion path and PCM boundary tests exist.
requirements.remaining: Run exact duration/channel-isolation checks for 44.1/48kHz and actual interface/browser combinations; fixtures are not MOTU evidence.

requirements.requirement: Show live level meter, clipping and no-signal/quality status; distinguish device-open from useful speech signal.
requirements.acceptance: Given silence 5 s, clipped signal 1 s, then normal speech, when captured, then named states appear within 1 s after each threshold; meter updates ≥10 Hz without capture stall.
requirements.evidence: Level, peak clipping and no-signal states are produced by capture.
requirements.remaining: A synthetic 16kHz one-second probe emits nine 1664-sample packets; cadence misses >=10Hz. Correct and measure real UI thresholds.

requirements.requirement: Handle hot unplug/replug using explicit lost-input state; no silent capture from default mic.
requirements.acceptance: Given active M4, when unplugged then reconnected, then listening/Auto stop on loss, no substitute opens and operator must retry/re-arm before sends.
requirements.evidence: Track-ended/device-change loss stops selected capture and pauses instead of substituting input.
requirements.remaining: Perform actual M4 unplug/replug and permission-loss trials, visible timing and deliberate rearm.

requirements.requirement: Bound audio buffering and detect dropped frames/overrun; discard stale processing and indicate loss.
requirements.acceptance: Given STT is stalled beyond 2 s audio queue budget, when more frames arrive, then overrun counter/status rises, old candidates/context invalidate and sends remain blocked until healthy restart.
requirements.rationale: Hidden lag can cause stale output.
requirements.evidence: Next-window capture is bounded and overflow/stale events invalidate recognition context.
requirements.remaining: Default ring is12s and pending-age allowance4s. Resolve the original2s queued-audio budget while inference owns the worker.

requirements.requirement: Provide input test, capture mute, pause and unambiguous listening status.
requirements.acceptance: Given test mode, when volunteer speaks then mutes/pauses, then level/preview work without output; mute feeds no speech onward and Pause closes capture, with visible status within 250 ms.
requirements.evidence: Consent, start/stop, pause, health and dry-run detection controls exist.
requirements.remaining: Verify real input-test usefulness and <=250ms visible mute/pause; a healthy meter is not an output test.

requirements.requirement: Document and detect OS-specific loopback prerequisites; prefer physical M4 input initially.
requirements.acceptance: Given an unavailable loopback route on either OS, when selected, then setup explains actual prerequisite and remains not-ready; no live routing change or paid driver install occurs.
requirements.evidence: Browser physical/virtual devices can be explicitly selected; physical M4 setup is documented.
requirements.remaining: OS-specific loopback prerequisite/capability detection is not a verified route; do not silently assume system loopback.

requirements.requirement: Continuous transcription via one backend; rolling readable preview, partial/final distinction, language/provider health.
requirements.acceptance: Given a 90-minute authorized feed, when speech/pauses occur, then ordered revisions replace partial text; no partial alone becomes sendable; errors show backend state and no unbounded transcript accumulation.
requirements.evidence: Continuous capture feeds bounded CLI/resident Whisper windows with rolling text and processing/stabilization states.
requirements.remaining: Adapter returns final window results rather than true incremental token streaming. Verify partial/final UX and real90-minute feed behavior.

requirements.requirement: Stabilize utterances with revision IDs, end evidence and correction grace before candidate eligibility.
requirements.acceptance: Given partial John 3 then revised John 3:16, when final/stability policy completes, then only stable full candidate is eligible; test rapid correction prevents old dispatch.
requirements.evidence: Window/session IDs, original age, revisions and citation stabilization guard candidate eligibility.
requirements.remaining: Validate real partial/revised/corrected speech and correction grace; synthetic assembly is not speech accuracy.

requirements.requirement: Canonical book dictionary includes 1/I/First John, Psalm/Psalms, Song of Songs/Solomon and Revelation/Revelations with provenance/version.
requirements.acceptance: Given alias corpus, when normalized, then each maps to exact canonical book; “John said” does not become a reference. Dictionary version recorded in diagnostics.
requirements.evidence: Canonical book/ordinal/alias dictionary and provenance metadata files exist.
requirements.remaining: Export an explicit parser/dictionary metadata version in diagnostics; application version alone does not meet that requirement.

requirements.requirement: Parse spoken numbers/ordinals and chapter/verse aliases for explicit references.
requirements.acceptance: Given “John three sixteen,” “turn to Romans chapter eight verse twenty-eight,” and “Second Timothy one seven,” when stable, then John 3:16, Romans 8:28 and 2 Timothy 1:7 are produced exactly.
requirements.evidence: Deterministic number, ordinal, chapter/verse and common citation normalization has regressions.
requirements.remaining: Retain the complete original corpus and evaluate the forms through actual STT, not text alone.

requirements.requirement: Validate canonical book/chapter/verse using rights-cleared metadata and selected translation capabilities; reject invalid or unknown bounds.
requirements.acceptance: Given John 3:99, unknown book and valid John 3:16, when validated, then first two are blocked with reason; valid reference proceeds only if translation availability verified.
requirements.evidence: KJV bounds are deterministic; other editions need explicit saved/native verification and cannot gain guessed relative Auto.
requirements.remaining: Complete installed-edition numbering/unavailable-reference trials; unknown bounds are not validated scripture existence.

requirements.requirement: Parse same-chapter and cross-chapter ranges with order and configurable finite limits, default max 10 verses.
requirements.acceptance: Given 1 Corinthians 13:4–7 and John 3:16–4:2, when parsed, then ordered bounds are retained; over-10 range needs explicit review/adjustment and never Auto.
requirements.evidence: Ordered same/cross-chapter ranges are parsed and capped at hardcoded ten verses.
requirements.remaining: Finite range limit is not configurable as required. Preserve edition bounds and non-Auto over-limit behavior when adding configuration.

requirements.requirement: Resolve relative “verse seventeen,” “next verse,” “go back to verse three” only from verified recent passage context.
requirements.acceptance: Given verified John 3:16 context, when next verse is spoken, then offer John 3:17; without context offer Needs review, never guess. Go back from John 3:17 yields John 3:3.
requirements.evidence: Relative navigation uses recent readback context and the actual displayed cue after PR48.
requirements.remaining: Verify actual next/previous/chapter-edge navigation and ambiguous fragments; unknown edition numbering still needs a full reference.

requirements.requirement: Reset context on explicit book change, service reset, manual passage change, uncertainty/disconnect and 120 s context timeout.
requirements.acceptance: Given John context, when another book/manual slide or timeout occurs, then relative-only speech cannot use prior John context. Unsupported manual-state detection disables relative Auto.
requirements.evidence: Book/intent/generation/target/ownership/age changes invalidate context; takeover checks run in the background.
requirements.remaining: Exercise real manual/Companion changes and disconnects; unsupported state detection must not enable relative Auto.

requirements.requirement: Reject numeric ambiguity, names/discussion lacking complete reference and non-scripture commands.
requirements.acceptance: Given “John says a lot about love,” “chapter three is important” without context and “three sixteen,” when processed, then no sendable reference is generated; ambiguous forms show review only when useful.
requirements.evidence: Discussion, incomplete numbers, invalid ordinals and non-reference wording have rejection cases.
requirements.remaining: Measure false suggestions on real negatives, including spoken names and sermon discussion.

requirements.requirement: Separate candidate detection from display intent under service policy; reference mention alone is not unconditional Auto permission.
requirements.acceptance: Given background lyric/reference discussion and an explicit pastor instruction, when classified, then background/discussion never Auto; configured policy and evidence appear on eligible candidate.
requirements.evidence: Explicit-command policy is default; bare citations require separate opt-in and bounded final speech.
requirements.remaining: Validate real background/lyrics/discussion policy and comprehension; heuristic eligibility is not calibrated probability.

requirements.requirement: Recognize self-corrections and invalidate superseded pending/queued candidates immediately, including within one utterance.
requirements.acceptance: Given “I meant John four sixteen, not John three sixteen,” when stabilized, then only John 4:16 remains; cancellation reaches dispatcher before any stale send.
requirements.evidence: Corrections/new intent cancel old candidates/preflights; dispatch rechecks ownership.
requirements.remaining: Run real correction timing and already-dispatched uncertainty with observed output.

requirements.requirement: Detect multiple references in detection order and require separate review, not sequential indiscriminate Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given Matthew 5:16 and then Romans 8:28 in one sentence, when parsed, then two ordered review candidates appear and neither auto-dispatches.
requirements.evidence: Multiple references remain ordered review candidates rather than an Auto sequence.
requirements.remaining: Verify actual multi-reference speech and volunteer selection without replacing unrelated output.

requirements.requirement: Translation requests normalize installed IDs; ambiguous AMP/AMPC and uninstalled requests require selection, never substitution.
requirements.acceptance: Given ESV unavailable or ambiguous “Amplified,” when requested, then send is blocked until explicit installed selection; previous default is not silently used.
requirements.evidence: Longest exact edition aliases distinguish AMP/AMPC; missing/ambiguous installed choices are blocked.
requirements.remaining: Complete every IFC edition/name/build matrix, including AMP/AMPC and no previous-default fallback.

requirements.requirement: Suppress duplicates using reference/range/translation identity and configurable cooldown, default 10 s; intentional manual resend remains distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Given repeated transcript windows for same reference within 10 s, when finalized, then one suggestion/command occurs; explicit resend after review gets new command ID.
requirements.evidence: Candidate IDs and a ten-second last-send cooldown suppress immediate repeats.
requirements.remaining: Cooldown is hardcoded rather than configurable; audit deliberate reviewed resend semantics before changing suppression or Auto.

requirements.requirement: Assign per-candidate TTL, default 15 s from stable detection, visible age/expiry; invalidate on policy/target/profile revisions.
requirements.acceptance: Given candidate aged >15 s, when clicked or shortcut held, then no send occurs and expired state remains visible; a fresh validation requires a new candidate ID.
requirements.evidence: Candidate TTL retains original speech age; stale/policy/target/profile changes invalidate actions.
requirements.remaining: Verify visible expired states and fresh passage-review tokens; intentional prepared review is separate validation, not stale Auto authority.

requirements.requirement: Maintain configurable STT-confusion aliases only with test evidence; uncertain recognition stays reviewable.
requirements.acceptance: Given confusable John/Job and real labelled examples, when normalization lacks unique evidence, then Needs review appears; no confidence threshold bypasses ambiguity.
requirements.evidence: A fixed tested whitelist handles reported spellings without broad fuzzy book guessing.
requirements.remaining: Configurable confusion aliases and independently labelled accent evidence remain incomplete; do not guess John/Job from confidence.

requirements.requirement: Quote/paraphrase matching is future explicit opt-in, independently validated and always Confirm; never Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given only paraphrased verse content, when future feature disabled, then no match; enabled uncertain suggestions cannot dispatch automatically.
requirements.evidence: Opt-in rights-cleared local indexes support partial/near-verbatim quotes, always Confirm.
requirements.remaining: Broad semantic paraphrases remain unavailable; real quote accuracy and index rights need validation. Original future/opt-in boundary remains.

requirements.requirement: Always display connection, audio health, listening state, effective mode and target/test status with text plus icon.
requirements.acceptance: Given offline link but healthy mic, when viewed full/compact, then separate statuses show offline and listening without a misleading overall connected label.
requirements.evidence: Separate connection/input/engine/mode/target indicators exist in full/compact workspaces.
requirements.remaining: Verify booth readability, degraded combinations and actual capture status on each OS.

requirements.requirement: Candidate card shows canonical reference, translation, source phrase, actionable evidence/ambiguity and large Show/Reject controls.
requirements.acceptance: Given valid and ambiguous candidates, when rendered, then exact reference/translation/source are visible; ambiguous card says Needs review and disables Show until resolved.
requirements.evidence: Reference/edition/source/review state and deliberate passage actions are implemented.
requirements.remaining: Confirm operator comprehension and complete real slide review; metadata preview is not physical output proof.

requirements.requirement: Confirm is startup/default mode; Auto requires explicit enablement after health/translation/ownership checks and remains visibly distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Given clean restart or recovered error, when app opens, then Auto is off; selecting Auto requires deliberate enable action and failed checks prevent arming.
requirements.evidence: Startup is Confirm/dry-run; guarded Auto needs explicit session policy/approval and is not restored from settings.
requirements.remaining: Complete supervised actual speech/edition/ownership readiness and independent output checks.

requirements.requirement: Suggest-only continues capture/detection but forbids all sends; Paused stops capture/detection/sends; resume does not replay queue.
requirements.acceptance: Given mode transitions with queued candidates, when entering either substate then resuming, then no send occurs from old queue and listening indicators reflect actual capture.
requirements.evidence: Suggest-only forbids sends; Paused revokes capture/queue authority; resume requires fresh intent.
requirements.remaining: Verify actual device closure/indicator timing and no replay during real recognition.

requirements.requirement: Emergency stop cancels unsent work, blocks manual/Auto sends, clears Auto arming and requires deliberate re-arm; cannot undo already-sent output.
requirements.acceptance: Given queued commands, when Stop clicked/focused Escape used, then send gate closes within 100 ms and no unsent command dispatches; already-sent is labelled accurately and no automatic clear occurs.
requirements.evidence: Stop invalidates queued work/arming; accepted late triggers remain uncertain rather than silently undone.
requirements.remaining: Measure <=100ms gate closure and actual loaded-host reaction; no automatic Clear is allowed.

requirements.requirement: Send via click/Space/Enter only in safe focused contexts; ignore key repeat; no global hotkeys by default.
requirements.acceptance: Given focus in reference edit/settings/another app or held key, when Space/Enter occurs, then no send; focused Show activation sends once after current-candidate recheck.
requirements.evidence: Focused activation and repeat-key controls exist; text entry is not a global send shortcut.
requirements.remaining: Complete keyboard/NVDA/VoiceOver and concurrent ProPresenter/Companion focus tests.

requirements.requirement: Optional system-wide shortcuts require opt-in, conflict review and OS permission explanation; emergency stop remains local accessible.
requirements.acceptance: Given conflicting Companion binding, when registering optional global shortcut, then conflict/permission failure is shown and binding remains inactive; default installation registers none.
requirements.evidence: No system-wide shortcut registration is implemented or enabled by default.
requirements.remaining: Optional opt-in/conflict/permission workflow remains deferred; preserve its original Could/v1 status.

requirements.requirement: Queue candidates by detection time, max 5 active; expire/skip invalidated items; newer references suppress stale Auto eligibility.
requirements.acceptance: Given >5 detections and correction/new reference, when queue changes, then expired/oldest unsent entries drop with notice; no stale command sends and ordering of retained suggestions is stable.
requirements.evidence: Queue is bounded to five, ordered by retained detections and invalidated on stale/new intent.
requirements.remaining: Verify useful drop/expiry indications and overload under representative service traffic.

requirements.requirement: Reject/Dismiss prevents that candidate sending or reappearing from identical STT revisions; fresh intentional request is distinguishable.
requirements.acceptance: Given dismissed John 3:16, when same utterance revision reappears, then no new sendable card occurs; a new later utterance gets a new identity.
requirements.evidence: Dismiss removes the candidate; utterance/revision/window guards prevent identical stale revisions regaining authority.
requirements.remaining: Validate dismissal versus fresh intentional requests under actual STT revisions.

requirements.requirement: Edit reference/range and immediate correction revalidate, cancel old command and show changed provenance; editing never implicitly sends.
requirements.acceptance: Given John 3:16 card, when changed to John 4:16, then old command is canceled; new card is Confirm-only and needs explicit Show after validation.
requirements.evidence: Edit dismisses the old card, focuses manual correction and needs a new reviewed request.
requirements.remaining: Verify real correction/dispatch races and changed provenance across windows.

requirements.requirement: Manual reference lookup works without STT, subject to connector/translation validation and intentional confirmation.
requirements.acceptance: Given STT offline and connector healthy, when operator types Romans 8:28 then confirms, then correct validated request can send; connector failure blocks clearly.
requirements.evidence: Manual ingress/review operates without the speech worker through the same connector checks.
requirements.remaining: Complete installed-host exact text/edition/theme/output acceptance with STT unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Recent history default N=20 in memory, with status/time and explicit resend that revalidates target/translation/ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Given history from another session/target or unavailable translation, when resend requested, then it is blocked; current valid item creates fresh Confirm-only command.
requirements.evidence: Twenty in-memory receipt/history rows offer fresh review rather than blind replay.
requirements.remaining: Verify target/edition/ownership revalidation and deliberate resend/cooldown in operator drills.

requirements.requirement: Provide previous/next verse, range adjustment and translation selection only where verified route supports them.
requirements.acceptance: Given chapter edge and unavailable translation, when navigation/switch requested, then canonical bounds validate and no substitute occurs; unsupported control is disabled with reason.
requirements.evidence: Previous/next and edition changes use verified context; unsupported numbering is restricted.
requirements.remaining: Complete actual chapter-edge/range/edition operations for all IFC versions and fitting formatting.

requirements.requirement: Full window and optional always-on-top compact control share one state/command authority; compact never becomes audience output.
requirements.acceptance: Given both views open, when selecting/rejecting/stopping in either, then the other matches within 250 ms; double activation across views produces one command.
requirements.evidence: Full/compact share backend authority, owner lease and state updates; duplicate actions are guarded.
requirements.remaining: Measure <=250ms parity and verify reset/transcript state across windows and late responses.

requirements.requirement: Clear control affects only verified authorized Bible/slide target; disable when scope/ownership uncertain and never map to Clear All.
requirements.acceptance: Given unrelated lyric/media or unverified clear semantics, when Clear is attempted, then it is disabled; approved test Bible clear preserves other layers in observed output.
requirements.evidence: Clear is disabled and delegated to ProPresenter; no Clear All mapping exists.
requirements.remaining: Bible-only clear semantics and preservation are not verified/implemented. Disabled safety behavior is not a working clear feature.

requirements.requirement: Configure host/IP/port and explicit selected instance with allowlist, connection test and actual version readout.
requirements.acceptance: Given wrong host/build/port, when test runs, then readiness fails with cause; no write is allowed until approved identity/version matches configured target.
requirements.evidence: Canonical private/loopback target, explicit connection test and version readout exist.
requirements.remaining: Verify approved instance/build/capability expectations and actual wrong-host/network cases.

requirements.requirement: Optional discovery restricted to explicitly enabled trusted subnet; never silently select/scan production network.
requirements.acceptance: Given multiple instances and discovery disabled, when app starts, then no discovery traffic occurs; enabled results require explicit selection/allowlisting before sends.
requirements.evidence: No automatic subnet scan/discovery or silent instance selection is implemented.
requirements.remaining: Optional trusted-subnet discovery/selection is deferred; default no-discovery remains enforced.

requirements.requirement: Validate installed translation, Bible availability, theme and Look expectations during setup/preflight; block unverifiable Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given missing/mismatched Bible/theme/Look, when preflight runs, then precise discrepancy shown and Auto unavailable; operator cannot bypass by changing confidence alone.
requirements.evidence: Exact title/edition identities, clipping blocks and Look/image/metadata approval binding exist.
requirements.remaining: Complete actual installed edition/theme/Look/routing checks; labels and HTTP success do not prove provenance or fidelity.

requirements.requirement: Resolve arbitrary normalized reference through proven documented route, preserving genuine ProPresenter Bible source and appearance.
requirements.acceptance: Given two required and an unprepared valid passage, when explicitly authorized test sends, then exact text/translation/theme and both output Looks match manual baseline; finite cache alone fails.
requirements.evidence: Restricted Windows preparation uses ProPresenter itself and creates/reuses exact saved copies for reference-driven review.
requirements.remaining: Direct documented arbitrary-reference Bible API is unverified/not documented; native Mac route is not implemented. Full P0 text/style/both-output tests remain.

requirements.requirement: Preserve stage/current state, routing and unrelated media; avoid unrelated lyrics/operator overrides, with ownership loss blocking Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given media playing and operator/Companion changes lyric state, when candidate is queued, then no unsolicited replacement occurs; loss of ownership cancels unsent command and shows Review needed.
requirements.evidence: Selected-arrangement and output/text ownership checks detect background takeover.
requirements.remaining: Run actual media/lyrics/operator/Companion coexistence with routed room/stream observations.

requirements.requirement: Track queued/sent/receipt/readback/output-observed/failed/uncertain separately; never claim observed output from HTTP success.
requirements.acceptance: Given accepted HTTP but disabled audience output, when result returns, then UI says receipt/readback only, not Live confirmed; independent output evidence required for observed label.
requirements.evidence: Receipt, matching readback, uncertainty and observed-output flags remain distinct.
requirements.remaining: Complete independent room/stream observations and lost/order receipt cases.

requirements.requirement: Serialize commands with local idempotency keys; uncertain completion is not blindly retried because server idempotency is unproven.
requirements.acceptance: Given response lost after dispatch, when timeout occurs, then status uncertain and automatic retry absent; explicit reconciliation/readback precedes any fresh operator resend.
requirements.evidence: One command owns dispatch; local IDs and uncertainty guards prevent blind uncertain retries.
requirements.remaining: Verify actual accepted/lost-response/reconnect cases without asserting server idempotency.

requirements.requirement: Diagnose offline/degraded/unsupported responses; bounded health retry and reconnect invalidate queued work, context and Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given ProPresenter closes/restarts or network drops, when health fails/recovers, then no stale sends occur, reasons shown, new identity/state checks and intentional re-arm required.
requirements.evidence: Health failures invalidate Auto/context and recovery requires intentional rearm.
requirements.remaining: Complete actual network/power/process matrix; new personal-host evidence is private and not claimed here.

requirements.requirement: Dry-run generates simulated command records without any output-affecting API or UI calls; test-target banner persists.
requirements.acceptance: Given dry-run and click/Auto/clear actions, when exercised, then network/output spy records zero side-effecting requests and no OS automation; simulated status never reads Live.
requirements.evidence: Dry-run paths simulate without triggers; banners and preparation capabilities are explicit.
requirements.remaining: Keep tests separating consented preparation from dry-run sends and exercise every active package action.

requirements.requirement: Unsupported mechanisms cannot become silent fallbacks; expose capability limits and fail closed.
requirements.acceptance: Given documented route unavailable, when sending, then route error appears; no UI automation/import/external Bible is attempted without separately approved design.
requirements.evidence: Unsupported paths fail explicitly; UI automation is a consented restricted fallback, not an invented Bible REST API.
requirements.remaining: Preserve OS/build/focus/copy gates and never silently substitute external text or a presentation engine.

requirements.requirement: First-run setup covers input/channel/permission, target/version, translation/theme expectations, no-output connection test, speaker test and Confirm choice.
requirements.acceptance: Given fresh settings, when setup completed with one failure, then failed readiness stays visible and no output occurs; valid completion ends in Confirm/dry-run until authorized target is armed.
requirements.evidence: Setup panels cover target, audio/channel, local worker and review expectations with safe defaults.
requirements.remaining: Verify speaker/input/readiness onboarding and volunteer learning; technical choices still need field usability review.

requirements.requirement: Profiles store nonsecret audio/target/translation/safety settings; profile switch invalidates queue/context and Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Given two profiles, when switching, then saved fields restore, credentials stay vault references, no old candidate survives and Auto is off.
requirements.evidence: Nonsecret profiles load through a paused disarmed transition, revoking old API/queue/approval state.
requirements.remaining: Complete current-input/path and cross-platform operator profile-switch drills.

requirements.requirement: Keep optional provider/API secrets in OS credential vault; logs/settings/export contain only opaque references.
requirements.acceptance: Given seeded test secret, when saving/exporting/crashing/building, then canary is absent from config/log/package; vault failure blocks cloud feature without plaintext fallback.
requirements.evidence: Cloud/provider-key persistence is absent; optional cloud features are blocked and private bearer tokens are ephemeral.
requirements.remaining: A future persistent-key provider still needs a real OS vault. No plaintext fallback or existing vault integration is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Structured local diagnostics include sanitized health, event IDs, timings and version/capability state, with bounded retention.
requirements.acceptance: Given error/timeout and sensitive inputs, when logged, then timestamp/category/severity/correlation appear, but audio/transcript/token fields do not; retention quota is enforced.
requirements.evidence: Event IDs/times/severity and bounded content-free timing fields stay in memory.
requirements.remaining: Verify full error taxonomy/correlation and crash/retention behavior; bounded events are not full operational attestation.

requirements.requirement: Export redacted logs via explicit action with preview; diagnostic upload requires separate consent and is absent by default.
requirements.acceptance: Given export, when inspected, then local paths/IPs/secrets/content are removed or masked and user chooses destination; no background upload occurs.
requirements.evidence: Diagnostics export previews consent and excludes content/paths/addresses; no background upload exists.
requirements.remaining: Complete package/crash/export canary and operator review tests on both OS variants.

requirements.requirement: Nonsecret settings import/export validates schema/ranges/host allowlist and cannot enable Auto or overwrite credentials.
requirements.acceptance: Given malicious/corrupt/imported Auto=true settings, when imported, then invalid fields rejected, secret fields ignored and resulting mode Confirm/Paused, never armed.
requirements.evidence: Known-field import/export strips authority/secrets/local paths and uses disarmed serialized changes.
requirements.remaining: Complete malformed/import configuration matrices and exported-value checks; imported Auto is forbidden.

requirements.requirement: Reset-to-safe and corrupt-settings recovery preserve optional backup, disable sends/cloud, and require setup revalidation.
requirements.acceptance: Given corrupt config or reset, when reopened, then app reaches safe setup rather than crashes/Auto; previous known-good nonsecret backup can be reviewed/restored.
requirements.evidence: PR53/54 add two validated recovery points, safe corrupt startup/notice and explicit receipt-bound reviewed restore.
requirements.remaining: Complete crash/filesystem/OS recovery matrix; no automatic backup, cue or authority restoration is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Independent STT/provider, parser/policy and connector interfaces expose capabilities and cancellation without assuming all backends support every feature.
requirements.acceptance: Given fake STT timeout or connector lacking range/readback, when used in contract test, then caller handles unavailable capability and disables dependent sends without changing parser semantics.
requirements.evidence: Capture/STT/parser/policy/connector contracts expose cancellation, capabilities and guarded dispatch.
requirements.remaining: Complete provider/OS failure/resource contract audits; a shared interface alone does not prove compatibility.

requirements.requirement: Consent settings make recording/transcript persistence/cloud use separate opt-ins with visible current status and deletion controls.
requirements.acceptance: Given defaults, when 90-minute session ends, then no audio/transcript file exists; optional retention explicitly enabled has expiry and deletion action that removes content as documented.
requirements.evidence: No intentional recording/transcript/cloud persistence option is enabled; local processing and quote-index rights are explicit.
requirements.remaining: Optional capture retention/deletion is not implemented. Inspect temporary WAV/crash/swap residue before privacy acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Enforce in-service update lock; MVP manual signed updates, v1 signed channel/rollback with explicit outside-service install.
requirements.acceptance: Given active service/update available, when update offered, then install waits for explicit end-of-service action; failed update restores prior config-compatible version without Auto.
requirements.planning: operations / MVP manual; v1 channel / BR-006
requirements.evidence: No automatic updater or in-service install action exists; review build paths are pinned.
requirements.remaining: Trusted signed manual updates and enforced service-lock/rollback distribution flow remain missing or unaccepted. Signing credentials/cost decisions are external.

requirements.requirement: Present accessible keyboard/screen-reader/status semantics, scalable booth text and non-color-only health.
requirements.acceptance: Given VoiceOver/NVDA, keyboard-only input and 200% text, when core tasks run, then all controls/statuses remain named, reachable and unclipped; no focus trap or accidental send.
requirements.evidence: Labels, keyboard routes, text statuses and200% fit checks exist, including recovery controls.
requirements.remaining: Complete screen-reader/booth tasks and reconcile original typography/target sizes with the chosen professional design.

requirements.requirement: Session reset clears transient audio/transcript/context/history/commands, retains safe nonsecret setup and never clears ProPresenter output implicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Given active session, when reset confirmed, then transient state is gone, mode returns Confirm/Paused and output spy sees zero clear/trigger requests.
requirements.rationale: End service without output side effects.
requirements.evidence: Backend reset cancels work and clears context/queue/history without ProPresenter Clear; clicked view clears transcript.
requirements.remaining: Verify/correct cross-window and late-response transcript residue; a clicked-view branch alone does not prove all transient text clears.

requirements.requirement: End-to-end latency, broken into capture, STT stabilization, parse, policy, connector and display segments.
requirements.acceptance: Auto p50 ≤2.0 s, p95 ≤4.0 s from t0; Confirm system-only same target, reaction excluded. Missing output fails, never silently excluded. Budget hypotheses: capture 100 ms, STT/stability 2400 ms, parse/policy 100 ms, connector/display 1400 ms at p95; segment quantiles do not mathematically sum to total quantile.
requirements.method: ≥30 references in P0 exploratory run; ≥200 explicit references for release, H-SHARED/H-LAN/H-WIN, synchronized audio/output video.
requirements.evidence: Original-age/worker/native timing instrumentation and synthetic metrics exist.
requirements.remaining: Require independent audible-end to physical room/stream timestamps on defined profiles; p50<=2s/p95<=4s remain unpassed.

requirements.requirement: Reference quality measured separately for exact book/chapter/start/end/translation and entire normalized tuple.
requirements.acceptance: Reference precision ≥95%, explicit-reference recall ≥90%; report component accuracies, phrase/context strata and all denominators. Insufficient representative data blocks claimed acceptance.
requirements.method: Held-out real sermon/speaker samples with independent labels; confusion matrix, precision/recall and confidence intervals; no synthetic accent evidence.
requirements.evidence: Synthetic parser coverage and an exploratory historical real-source pilot exist.
requirements.remaining: Require independently labelled held-out recordings, denominators/component accuracy/confidence intervals; tuned or synthetic cases are not accent evidence.

requirements.requirement: Safe Auto precision and false-positive burden.
requirements.acceptance: Zero unapproved wrong-verse/translation/stale displays; report safe-auto precision and false positives/hour separately, target ≤0.1 false suggestions/hour on real negatives, no false Auto displays. Zero events does not prove zero future risk.
requirements.method: 10 h representative supervised rehearsal including negative/background speech; log proposed, blocked and actual outputs.
requirements.evidence: Auto excludes quotes, ambiguity, stale/lossy/assembled speech and unapproved cues.
requirements.remaining: Ten-hour representative supervised wrong-output/false-positive rehearsal has not been established by unit/fixture runs.

requirements.requirement: All send predicates fail closed; ambiguity, stale commands, translation uncertainty, identity/ownership loss block Auto.
requirements.acceptance: Zero unsafe dispatches; intentional human validation cannot override unavailable Bible/unknown target. Stop gate closes ≤100 ms; already-dispatched output accurately marked.
requirements.method: Fault injection across every predicate before dispatch plus race tests.
requirements.evidence: Fault/race guards cover target, source, approval, ownership, Stop and uncertain dispatch.
requirements.remaining: Complete every predicate/<=100ms Stop measurement and actual output observation on loaded hosts.

requirements.requirement: Minimum continuity and soak.
requirements.acceptance: Zero crashes, deadlocks, unbounded queues or unintended media interruptions; RSS growth after warmup ≤100 MB over 3 h; recognition gaps visible.
requirements.method: 90-min production-like session and 3-h soak per primary host topology with silence, references, memory snapshots and media baseline.
requirements.evidence: Historical version-scoped minimized fixture soaks and bounded queues give component evidence.
requirements.remaining: Current90-minute/three-hour real audio/media/hardware/memory acceptance per topology remains required. Historical fixture soaks are not this certificate.

requirements.requirement: Shared-host CPU/RAM/GPU containment.
requirements.acceptance: Proposed VerseCue steady RSS ≤1.5 GiB for chosen small-model configuration; average normalized CPU ≤25% of total capacity, sustained >40% for 10 s triggers degradation; zero added playback drops at observed granularity. Shared GPU/ANE effects measured, no guarantee from model size. Dedicated companion proposed ≤2 GiB RSS / ≤50% total CPU; refine with IFC-approved evidence before release.
requirements.method: Compare ProPresenter-alone vs added VerseCue under identical representative load; collect per-process and system metrics at 1 s intervals.
requirements.evidence: CPU-only local worker/model settings and suspension controls exist.
requirements.remaining: Measure ProPresenter-alone versus VerseCue CPU/RAM/GPU/playback at specified intervals/thresholds and verify resource-degradation behavior.

requirements.requirement: Offline/local availability.
requirements.acceptance: Capture/transcription/parser remain functional; no cloud dependency or hidden upload, no model download during service; missing model yields actionable setup block.
requirements.method: Block internet after verified local model/assets installation; run 90-min session; allow only approved local ProPresenter traffic.
requirements.evidence: Runtime assets are local; missing worker/model is actionable and target network scope is constrained.
requirements.remaining: Complete real offline90-minute operation and network inspection; architecture alone does not prove absence of every external request.

requirements.requirement: Reconnect/backpressure safety.
requirements.acceptance: Audio queue ≤2 s, active candidates ≤5, at most one command in flight; no stale replay/blind resend; connection failure identified within 5 s under configured health policy. Recovery requires new validation/intentional re-arm.
requirements.method: Drop LAN, inject 1/5% loss and 100/500 ms delay, kill STT, close/restart ProPresenter, lose send response.
requirements.evidence: Queue/command bounds and no-blind-replay recovery guards exist.
requirements.remaining: Pending age4s and retained next audio up to12s conflict with2s queued audio. Correct semantics and run the specified network/worker/process fault loads.

requirements.requirement: Device and power recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Capture/sends stop on loss; no substitute mic; UI responds ≤1 s to detected device event; wake clears context/Auto and requests preflight. Monotonic TTL unaffected by wall-clock jumps.
requirements.method: M4 unplug/replug, revoke permission, sleep/wake, clock change.
requirements.evidence: Capture-clock/session loss and suspend/resume require fresh authorization/preflight.
requirements.remaining: Observe actual MOTU permission/hotplug, sleep/wake and wall-clock/device timing thresholds.

requirements.requirement: Default content minimization and retention.
requirements.acceptance: Zero persisted audio/transcript by default. Transient audio ring max 10 s, STT input queue max 2 s; rolling transcript max 2 min in RAM; clear at reset/exit; OS swap/crash limitations disclosed. Optional capture explicit consent, default expiry 7 days with startup/daily deletion.
requirements.method: Disk/network inspection before/after 90 min, process/log/crash artifact review with seeded text.
requirements.evidence: Normal CLI WAV cleanup is in finally; Node resident transport uses memory bytes; transcripts are not intentionally persisted.
requirements.remaining: Default ring12s/pending4s exceed10s/2s. Audit crash WAV/swap residue, cross-window reset and optional seven-day capture retention.

requirements.requirement: Secret confidentiality and cloud consent/TLS.
requirements.acceptance: Zero canary leakage; OS vault or feature blocked. No cloud request without explicit consent; TLS certificate validation mandatory, no downgrade. Cloud terms/retention/region reviewed before enabling future provider.
requirements.planning: security / MVP boundary; v2 cloud / BR-004
requirements.method: Canary secrets through logs/export/settings/crash/packages; network interception on test endpoint; consent off/on tests.
requirements.evidence: Cloud/persistent provider keys are inactive; known-field settings/backups and diagnostics omit credential fields.
requirements.remaining: Complete canary/crash/package/network evidence. Future cloud needs real vault/consent/TLS/terms validation.

requirements.requirement: Local API network least privilege.
requirements.acceptance: No public listener/port-forward; client targets only configured approved instance, redirects disabled; send blocked on identity/capability mismatch. Unencrypted/unauthenticated local API risk disclosed and trusted-segment controls approved.
requirements.method: Review bound interfaces/firewall/allowlist and wrong-host tests in authorized lab.
requirements.evidence: Private IPv4 allowlist/no redirects and loopback authenticated/capability-gated API exist.
requirements.remaining: Verify deployment host/network/firewall risk and approved segmentation in an authorized lab; no public listener or security-setting change is implied.

requirements.requirement: Supported OS/CPU matrix and clean packaging.
requirements.acceptance: All claimed combinations pass capture/recognition/connector/UI tests; no universal OS promise. Windows 10 support cannot be claimed until lifecycle/security/runtime decision recorded. No admin needed for ordinary run; optional driver privilege separate.
requirements.method: Install/run/uninstall signed artifacts on pinned Windows 11 x64, compatible macOS Apple Silicon and Intel; evaluate Windows 10 edition/runtime support separately.
requirements.evidence: Windows x64 and Apple Silicon development packaging/source UI checks run. Native Bible preparation is Windows-only.
requirements.remaining: Actual clean-host capture/recognition/connector/uninstall matrix, Intel Mac and Windows10 decision remain; hosted Mac build is not native Bible parity.

requirements.requirement: Signing, notarization, update rollback and uninstall cleanliness.
requirements.acceptance: Unsigned/tampered package rejected; macOS app/helpers notarized as applicable and Windows trusted signature verified. No in-service update; rollback recovers safe mode. Uninstall removes app/autostart/helpers; user data preserved/deleted by explicit choice, never ProPresenter assets.
requirements.planning: desktop + ops / MVP manual; v1 channel / BR-006
requirements.method: Verify signatures/tickets on clean hosts; corrupt/tamper update, fail mid-install, rollback old config; inspect residue.
requirements.evidence: Hashes/manifests/native source receipts and local development Mac signing exist.
requirements.remaining: These do not meet trusted Windows signing/Apple notarization. Credentials, tamper/install/rollback/uninstall tests and service lock remain missing/external. No paid purchase is authorized.

requirements.requirement: Booth readability and contrast.
requirements.acceptance: Core controls ≥44×44 logical px; base text ≥18 px, candidate reference ≥32 px; normal text ≥4.5:1 and large text/status graphics ≥3:1; no color-only status/clipping. These are project targets, no certification claimed.
requirements.method: Observe at IFC booth distance (record actual distance/lighting), 200% scaling/text, contrast measurement.
requirements.evidence: Figma/Studio direction includes text/icon states and responsive/200% layout checks.
requirements.remaining: Root14px/smaller fonts and some sub44px controls do not establish original18px/44px targets. Reconcile booth mode/design or record an explicit approved target change.

requirements.requirement: Keyboard/screen reader/focus usability.
requirements.acceptance: All core tasks complete, labelled states/actions announced, no trap/repeated-key accidental send; status announcement does not steal focus. Compact parity required if offered.
requirements.method: VoiceOver macOS, NVDA Windows, keyboard-only focus traversal, reduced motion and multiwindow tests.
requirements.evidence: Focus/repeat-key/keyboard/layout and shared-window ownership tests exist.
requirements.remaining: Complete NVDA/VoiceOver announcements, reduced motion, all task traversal and compact parity on actual systems.

requirements.requirement: Volunteer learning time.
requirements.acceptance: ≤5 min orientation and 100% safety tasks without coach intervention; record hesitation/errors and fix dangerous confusion.
requirements.method: ≥3 representative volunteers after completed setup, each follows 5-min guide then detection/Show/reject/pause/stop/failback tasks.
requirements.evidence: Five-minute guide and operator readiness/review controls are documented.
requirements.remaining: At least three representative volunteers must complete orientation/safety tasks without coaching; agent UI tests cannot replace them.

requirements.requirement: Module contracts and reproducible delivery.
requirements.acceptance: No provider bypass of safety gate; exact source/dependency/model versions traceable; binary differences documented for signatures/toolchains; no missing license/SBOM entry.
requirements.method: Contract/fault tests with fake capture/STT/connector, pinned manifest/model hashes, reproduce builds on clean controlled environments.
requirements.evidence: Lock/model pins, manifests, receipts and dependency/font inventories provide provenance evidence.
requirements.remaining: Inventory applicationVersion is0.5.7 while source is0.6.0. Refresh/verify it and complete clean reproducibility/license/SBOM coverage; hashes are not signing.

requirements.requirement: Structured diagnostics/crash recovery/config backup.
requirements.acceptance: Safe restart without Auto, no output mutation on startup; logs ≤20 MB/7 days, no default content; last two valid nonsecret config backups recover; error category/action available without tokens.
requirements.method: Force worker/app crash and corrupt settings; inspect rotating logs and restore procedure.
requirements.evidence: Safe startup, bounded metadata, two validated backups and reviewed paused restoration are implemented/tested.
requirements.remaining: Complete actual forced app/worker crash, filesystem/corruption/artifact-retention and operator recovery matrix; normal tests do not cover every crash point.

requirements.requirement: Dependency/security review.
requirements.acceptance: No unreviewed critical/high exploitable findings or hardcoded credentials; documented mitigation/owner and IFC acceptance needed for any exception. Signed-update key never in app.
requirements.method: Lockfile/SBOM/license scan and targeted threat review at each release; no new build tools selected now.
requirements.evidence: Pinned dependencies/component inventories exist; no update signing key is bundled.
requirements.remaining: Perform current release dependency/security/license review with exception ownership; green builds are not vulnerability clearance.

requirements.requirement: Translation and third-party rights.
requirements.acceptance: Zero copyrighted translation redistribution without written applicable rights; all required notices included; installed Bible/stream use and external preview rights checked separately; unknown rights block affected path.
requirements.method: Per-edition/OS/model/font/binary/service license inventory and rights review; inspect package for verse databases.
requirements.evidence: Paid verse databases are not bundled; installed-source preparation, notices and quote-index rights acknowledgment exist.
requirements.remaining: Complete applicable per-edition/host/stream/preview rights and runtime-notice coverage; unknown rights still block affected paths.

requirements.requirement: Operational availability and manual recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Ordinary ProPresenter continues without VerseCue; volunteer reaches manual Bible workflow ≤30 s without restarting ProPresenter or disrupting media; failed automation visibly contained.
requirements.method: Independent operator drills with app killed and network/audio failures; document timings.
requirements.evidence: ProPresenter remains the output owner; takeover/no-Clear failback boundaries exist.
requirements.remaining: Independent operator drills must prove <=30s manual recovery without media interruption under actual app/network/audio faults.

requirements.requirement: No required metered operating service.
requirements.acceptance: USD 0 required STT/API usage/session; any signing/hardware/development/renewal costs explicit and separately approved; no account/card requirement hidden in onboarding.
requirements.method: Offline test plus bill-of-materials/cost review; model and dependency distribution terms checked.
requirements.evidence: Local runtime needs no metered STT/API provider or hidden account/card.
requirements.remaining: Verify offline service/distribution terms; hardware/development/signing costs remain explicit and separately approved.

requirements.requirement: Command/receipt integrity and truthful feedback.
requirements.acceptance: One dispatch per accepted local command; no claim of server idempotence; uncertain status on lost acknowledgment; observed-output status only with genuine independent observation, otherwise receipt/readback wording.
requirements.method: Side-effect spy, response-loss/order/duplicate/concurrency and screen observation tests.
requirements.evidence: Command IDs, serialization and receipt/readback/uncertainty have side-effect-spy regressions.
requirements.remaining: Complete actual loss/order/concurrency/physical-observation cases; never infer server idempotence or observed output from HTTP success.
